# Roa'a Dream Explainar - LLM Context

## About
Roa'a Dream Explainar (رؤى لتفسير الأحلام) is a professional dream interpretation service. We provide accurate and reliable dream interpretations with complete privacy.

## Key Information
- Motto: نفهم حلمك، لنضيء دربك (We understand your dream, to light your path)
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English
- Contact: WhatsApp +967 771 170 068
- Email: maryam.ham60@gmail.com
- Working Hours: After Fajr prayer (Cairo local time)

## Services
- Personal dream interpretation
- Recurring dream consultation
- Vision and dream analysis

## Payment Methods
- Al-Kuraimi: Yemeni Rial, Saudi Riyal, US Dollar
- InstaPay: Egyptian Pound

## Rules
- Payment before interpretation
- Keep dream private for accurate interpretation
- Write dream immediately after waking
- Complete privacy guaranteed
- Cite source (Roa'a) when sharing
